[PharmaChoice](https://www.pharmachoice.com/)—operating primarily as a cooperative network of independent member pharmacies—sells and distributes standard major national brand pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, and health goods, alongside its proprietary private-label lines such as **Option+**, **For Your Everyday**, and partner brands like **Nosh & Co.** Specific generic and OTC formulations across their network are sourced from various specialized pharmaceutical manufacturers and co-packers, including companies like **Pharmetics**, **Vita Health Products**, and **Pendopharm**. [](https://ca.linkedin.com/company/pharmachoicecanada)

- **Option+**: Pharmacist-vetted over-the-counter health products and remedies featuring identical active ingredients to national brands.

- **For Your Everyday**: Value-priced everyday essentials spanning cosmetics, beauty, and health.

- **Nosh & Co.**: Snacks and confectionary items offered across front-shop retail locations. [](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDhfNOiuMPj/)

### Known Manufacturing & Supplying Partners

- **Pharmetics**: Supplies over-the-counter general relief and analgesic lines (e.g., store-brand acetaminophen).

- **Vita Health Products**: Provides specialty and standard analgesic/cold formulations (such as acetaminophen-codeine combinations).

- **Pendopharm**: Manufactures select pharmaceutical and therapeutic stock distributed through member locations.

PharmaChoice refers to two distinct well-known entities in the healthcare sphere: the Canadian retail pharmacy cooperative
and the specialized cleanroom/compounding brand owned by Acute Care Pharmaceuticals.
1. PharmaChoice Canada (Retail & Private Labels)
PharmaChoice Canada is a member-owned co-operative of over 1,100 independent community pharmacies.
Product Brands:
Option+:
The primary private-label health and wellness brand offering over-the-counter medications, vitamins, first-aid, and personal care.
For Your Everyday:
Budget-friendly everyday living, beauty, and health essentials.
Nosh & Co.:
Confectionery, snacks, and wholesome treats.
Essential Products by Savvy:
Household cleaning and paper products (dish soaps, facial tissues, cleaners).
Manufacturer & Distribution Partners:
Stock major national and global pharmaceutical brand products (such as Pfizer Canada).
Supported by major Canadian drug wholesalers and national supply chain networks.
